fact.box: CoinShares Bitcoin Mining and Digital Power ETF (WGMI), Nasdaq
fact.claim: On Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the CoinShares Bitcoin Mining and Digital Power ETF (WGMI) closed down 8.59%. The S&P 500 rose 1.62% that same day, after midterm election results. WGMI owns bitcoin miners that have moved into AI hosting, not bitcoin itself, so it can fall on a day the wider market goes up. This is one day's closing move and does not predict what the fund will do next.
